name: Cache Debugger
description: Admin toggle that turns Drupal's render-cache debug output on or off by managing sites/default/services.yml.
project_description:
The Cache Debugger module offers a straightforward interface to enable or disable render cache debugging for your Drupal site. This feature is particularly useful in development environments where inspecting cache behavior and troubleshooting caching issues are necessary without directly modifying the services.yml file.

 To activate render cache debugging, go to the module's configuration page at /admin/config/development/cache-debugger and check "Enable render cache debugging".

 Under the hood the module toggles the container parameter twig/render debug: when enabled it creates sites/default/services.yml from default.services.yml with debug: true and flushes all caches; when disabled it deletes services.yml and flushes caches again. With debug on, Drupal wraps every rendered element with HTML comments listing its cache tags, contexts, keys and max-age.

 Please note that this module is intended for use in development environments only and should never be enabled on production sites due to the significant performance impact of cache debugging.
